title: Line Ambassador Bed – Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Line Ambassador Bed is a tall upholstered bed frame with vertical panel line detailing across the headboard, giving a smart, tailored look at home. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, with a deeply padded headboard on a solid timber frame. Choose from 12 colours in five sizes, from £337.99 in Single 3ft to £506.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Vertical panel line detailing on tall headboard
  • Deeply padded upholstered headboard
  • Solid timber frame
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single (3FT): £337.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £376.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £389.99
  • King (5FT): £428.99
  • Super-King (6FT): £506.99

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home. The listing offers Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown.

Mattress compatibility

This is a bed frame with no built-in storage. Order the size that matches your mattress, or add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99.

Customisation

Pick your size and colour on the product page. If your colour is not listed, ask us about a custom fabric and colour.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Which upholstered bed?

The Line Ambassador (this bed, from £337.99) has vertical panel line detailing on a tall headboard. If you prefer a traditional, enclosed look, compare the Hilton Wingback Bed (from £337.99); for a traditional tufted look, see the Royal Chesterfield Wingback Bed (from £324.99). The Mirror Strip Sunrise Bed starts at £285.99. See more upholstered beds, or our guide to choosing an upholstered bed.

FAQ

What is a Line Ambassador bed?

It is a luxury upholstered bed frame with vertical panel line detailing on a tall, deeply padded headboard.

Which sizes and colours are available?

Single, Small Double, Double, King and Super King, in 12 colours. See the size list above and the colour options on the page.

Does it have storage?

No, it is a bed frame without built-in storage. For storage see our ottoman beds.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

Is delivery really free?

Yes. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and usually takes 3–5 working days from our own team. Northern Ireland delivery is £90.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
